hook.line: Three clones of him: one says he is like getting your book on the front shelf.
hook.visual: Three copies of the creator in a living room, orange SEO/AEO/GEO labels over their heads, a bookshop photo in the frame on the wall, a 1-2 word caption mid-screen.

beats.what: SEO clone speaks first; wall frame shows a bookshop shelf (the 'front shelf' analogy).
AEO clone takes over; wall frame switches to a teacher calling on a raised hand.
GEO clone gives the 'teacher writes your name on the board' analogy; frame goes blank white.
Second round: each clone says where it matters, starting with SEO for Google and Bing.
AEO round: the Siri logo appears in the wall frame as voice assistants are named.
GEO round: the Perplexity logo fills the frame as AI answer engines are named.
Third round, how to optimise: a search autocomplete list in the frame for 'keywords'.
AEO optimisation: an FAQ page screenshot in the frame for 'direct answers'.
GEO optimisation: a painting of a head full of books for 'original research'.
Frame shows orange text 'I'll send you what I use. Comment Marketing' as he asks.

characters.who: Three clones of the creator labelled SEO, AEO and GEO
characters.enters: All three are on screen from frame one, standing in fixed spots with their labels.
characters.acts: Take turns speaking in a fixed SEO-AEO-GEO order across three rounds; the wall frame shows the matching picture.
characters.exits: Never leave; all three stand in place to the last frame.

why_it_works: Three labelled clones turn an abstract comparison into who-is-talking, so the viewer tracks three ideas by position.
A repeating three-round structure (what it is, where it matters, how to optimise) sets up a rhythm the viewer can predict.
Each analogy (bookshop shelf, teacher calling on a kid, name on the board) is shown as a picture in the wall frame as it is said.
Comment-keyword CTA ('Marketing') drives comments with a promised tool.
weaknesses: Only 3 cuts in 38 s; one locked shot runs 28 s, so the picture changes come only from the small wall frame.
Face is small (6% of frame height) because three bodies share the frame.
The wall frame goes blank white for several seconds around 7-15 s, losing the visual support.
for_robert: Give Fred a labelled role and let him and Robert trade lines in a fixed order (e.g. Robert = SEO, Fred = GEO), with a picture frame in the scene that changes per line; avoid leaving that frame empty.
